Unauthorized S3 Bucket Access [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-284] on SourceDataBucket, ProcessedDataBucket: Misconfigured bucket policies, overly permissive IAM roles, or disabled bucket public access blocks could allow unauthorized access to sensitive data. An attacker could exploit misconfigured bucket permissions to list, download, or modify sensitive data in the S3 buckets.

Insecure Data Transmission [Information Disclosure, Tampering, Spoofing, CWE-319] on Mobile Device, Tablet/Laptop, Lambda, StepFunctions, S3: Without proper encryption in transit and endpoint validation, data could be intercepted during transmission or sent from unauthorized endpoints. An attacker could perform a man-in-the-middle attack to intercept data being uploaded to S3 or use compromised credentials to upload malicious data.

Insufficient Key Management [Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-320] on Lambda, Glue, StepFunctions, S3: Lack of proper key rotation, storage, or access controls for encryption keys and secrets could lead to compromise. An attacker gaining access to unrotated keys or improperly stored secrets could decrypt sensitive data or gain unauthorized access to services.

ETL Job Manipulation [Tampering, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-915] on Glue ETL Jobs, Glue Crawler, Lambda: Malicious input data or compromised ETL scripts could lead to data manipulation or resource exhaustion. An attacker could inject malicious data or modify ETL scripts to exfiltrate or corrupt data, or consume excessive resources.

Insufficient Disaster Recovery [Denial of Service, CWE-1051] on S3, Glue, StepFunctions, Lambda: Without proper backup and recovery procedures, system failures or attacks could result in permanent data loss or extended downtime. A ransomware attack or accidental deletion could result in data loss if proper backup and recovery mechanisms are not in place.

Data Sovereignty Violation [Information Disclosure, CWE-311] on S3, Glue, Lambda, StepFunctions: Data processed or stored in non-compliant regions could violate regulatory requirements and data sovereignty laws. Processing EU citizen data in non-EU regions could result in regulatory violations and fines.

Insufficient Monitoring and Alerting [Repudiation, Information Disclosure, CWE-223] on CloudWatch, EventBridge, SNS, Lambda, Glue: Without proper monitoring and alerting, security incidents or system issues could go undetected or be detected too late for effective response. An attacker could perform data exfiltration or resource abuse without detection due to insufficient monitoring.
